Key Code Pattern (Cast Spell):

@router.post("/cast")
async def cast_spell(request: CastSpellRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    try:
        valid_schools = ["feuer", "eis", "blitz", "wasser", "erde", "wind", "licht", "dunkelheit", "explosion"]
        if request.school not in valid_schools:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail={"error": f"Ungültige Schule: {request.school}"})
        
        progress = get_or_create_school_progress(db, request.player_id, request.school)
        
        # Add XP (1 damage = 1 XP)
        progress.xp += request.damage_dealt
        progress.total_casts += 1
        
        # Level up logic
        leveled_up = False
        while progress.xp >= progress.xp_required:
            progress.xp -= progress.xp_required
            progress.level += 1
            leveled_up = True
            progress.xp_required = 100 * (1.2 ** progress.level)
            
            if progress.level >= 20:
                progress.can_weave = True
        
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(progress)
        
        return {"success": True, "level": progress.level, "can_weave": progress.can_weave}
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
Features Implemented:

9 schools tracking per player
Weaving unlocks at Level 20
Explosion NEVER weavable (Gebot #3 rule)
Perfect cast tracking (damage >= 50)
XP-based leveling with 1.2x multiplier

class SlimeCompanion(Base):
    __tablename__ = "slime_companions"
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    companion_id = Column(Integer, unique=True, index=True)
    owner_player_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    
    # Stats
    name = Column(String(100))
    level = Column(Integer, default=1)
    xp = Column(Integer, default=0)
    
    # Fantasy Tier
    fantasy_tier = Column(String(20))  # "tier", "slime", "rainbow"
    metamorphosed = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    
    # Tamagotchi Needs
    hunger = Column(Float, default=100.0)
    thirst = Column(Float, default=100.0)
    schlaf = Column(Float, default=100.0)
    
    # JSON Fields
    collected_colors = Column(JSON, default=list)
    moves = Column(JSON, default=list)

"""

Instrument Progress Models - Najika World

Database models for instrument playing system

"""

 

from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey, Text, JSON

from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship

from datetime import datetime

from backend.database import Base

 

 

class InstrumentProgress(Base):

    """Player progress per instrument"""

    __tablename__ = "instrument_progress"

 

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)

    player_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False)

 

    # Current Instrument

    current_instrument = Column(String(50), default="mundharmonika")  # InstrumentType

2. Key Technical Concepts:
Game Mechanics:

Triple Triad System: 3×3 grid board, directional values (top/right/bottom/left), capture mechanics, Same/Plus rules
Hearthstone System: Mana system (1-10), card types (minion/spell/weapon), deck building (30 cards), hero powers
DDM System: Dice rolling, board movement, crest system, dungeon master HP
Backend Technologies:

FastAPI: Modern Python web framework with automatic API docs
SQLAlchemy ORM: Database abstraction with declarative models
Alembic: Database migration tool for version control
Pydantic: Request/response validation with BaseModel
Dependency Injection: FastAPI's Depends(get_db) pattern
Database Concepts:

Foreign Keys: Relationships between tables (player_id → users.id, card_id → cards.id)
JSON Columns: Storing complex data (effect_script, deck cards dict, board state)
ELO Rating System: For ranked matchmaking (1000 base)
Rank Tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Legend
Game Design:

Fantasy-Western Setting: Fire Gunslingers, Ice Mages, Lightning Outlaws, Nature Rangers, Shadow Necromancers, Holy Templars
Card Rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary
Dual Stats System: Each card has both Triple Triad values (4 directional) and Hearthstone stats (mana/attack/health)

class Card(Base):
    """Card definition (static card pool)"""
    __tablename__ = "cards"
    
    # Basic Info
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False, unique=True)
    card_type = Column(String(20), nullable=False)  # minion, spell, weapon
    faction = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    rarity = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    
    # Triple Triad Stats (directional values 1-10)
    top_value = Column(Integer, default=1)
    right_value = Column(Integer, default=1)
    bottom_value = Column(Integer, default=1)
    left_value = Column(Integer, default=1)
    
    # Hearthstone Stats
    mana_cost = Column(Integer, default=1)  # 0-10
    attack = Column(Integer, default=1)
    health = Column(Integer, default=1)
    durability = Column(Integer, default=3)  # For weapons
    
    # Effects
    effect_type = Column(String(50), nullable=True)
    effect_description = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    effect_script = Column(JSON, nullable=True)
    
    def to_dict(self):
        # Returns structured dict with triad_values and hearthstone_stats nested
class PlayerCardCollection(Base):
    """Player's owned cards"""
    __tablename__ = "player_card_collections"
    
    player_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False)
    card_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("cards.id"), nullable=False)
    copies_owned = Column(Integer, default=1)  # Multiple copies allowed
    is_golden = Column(Boolean, default=False)  # Premium version
    times_played = Column(Integer, default=0)
    times_won_with = Column(Integer, default=0)
class PlayerDeck(Base):
    """Player's card decks (30 cards)"""
    __tablename__ = "player_decks"
    
    deck_name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    faction = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    cards = Column(JSON, nullable=False)  # {"card_id": count} totaling 30
    total_games = Column(Integer, default=0)
    total_wins = Column(Integer, default=0)
    win_rate = Column(Float, default=0.0)
class CardGameMatch(Base):
    """Card game match history"""
    __tablename__ = "card_game_matches"
    
    player1_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    player2_id = Column(Integer, nullable=True)  # Null = vs NPC
    game_mode = Column(String(20))  # triad, hearthstone, hybrid
    is_ranked = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    is_vs_npc = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    npc_name = Column(String(100), nullable=True)
    winner_id = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
    final_board = Column(JSON, nullable=True)  # 3x3 grid for Triple Triad
    gold_earned = Column(Integer, default=0)
    xp_earned = Column(Integer, default=0)
    cards_won = Column(JSON, nullable=True)
class CardGameRanking(Base):
    """Player rankings for card game"""
    __tablename__ = "card_game_rankings"
    
    player_id = Column(Integer, unique=True)
    elo_rating = Column(Integer, default=1000)
    rank_tier = Column(String(20), default="bronze")
    ranked_wins = Column(Integer, default=0)
    ranked_losses = Column(Integer, default=0)
    win_streak = Column(Integer, default=0)
    best_win_streak = Column(Integer, default=0)
    season = Column(Integer, default=1)

"""

Housing & Farming Models - Najika World

Schwarze Mühle Living Quarters System

"""

 

from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, JSON, ForeignKey, Boolean, DateTime

from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship

from datetime import datetime

from backend.database import Base

 

 

class PlayerHouse(Base):

    """Player's house in Schwarze Mühle"""

    __tablename__ = "player_houses"

 

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)

    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('users.id'), nullable=False)

 

    # Location

    region = Column(String(50), default="schwarze_muehle")  # schwarze_muehle, heisse_duenen, etc.

class Card(Base):
    __tablename__ = "cards"
    # Triple Triad Stats (directional values 1-10)
    top_value = Column(Integer, default=1)
    right_value = Column(Integer, default=1)
    bottom_value = Column(Integer, default=1)
    left_value = Column(Integer, default=1)
    # Hearthstone Stats
    mana_cost = Column(Integer, default=1)
    attack = Column(Integer, default=1)
    health = Column(Integer, default=1)

Why: Defines housing and farming database schema for living quarters system

class PlayerHouse(Base):
    __tablename__ = "player_houses"
    furniture = Column(JSON, default=list)  # [{"type": "bed", "position": {...}, "rotation": 0}]
    level = Column(Integer, default=1)
    max_furniture = Column(Integer, default=20)

class FarmPlot(Base):
    __tablename__ = "farm_plots"
    crop_type = Column(String(50), nullable=True)
    growth_stage = Column(Integer, default=0)  # 0-4
    ready_to_harvest = Column(Boolean, default=False)

class CardGameUI {
    constructor() {
        this.apiBase = {
            cards: '/api/cards',
            decks: '/api/decks',
            matches: '/api/matches',
            rankings: '/api/rankings'
        };
        this.playerId = 1;
        this.board = Array(9).fill(null); // 3x3 Triple Triad board
    }
    
    async showCollection() {
        const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBase.cards}/collection/${this.playerId}`);
        // Renders cards with Triple Triad values and Hearthstone stats
    }
}

class Region(Base):
    __tablename__ = "regions"
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    region_code = Column(String(50), unique=True)
    position_x = Column(Integer)  # 0-9600
    position_y = Column(Integer)  # 0-9600
    width = Column(Integer)
    height = Column(Integer)
    biome_type = Column(String(50))  # "desert", "forest", etc.
    slime_color = Column(String(50))
    terrain_config = Column(JSON)
    features = Column(JSON)
    dangers = Column(JSON)
    resources = Column(JSON)

class HousingUI {
    constructor() {
        this.apiBase = {housing: '/api/housing', farming: '/api/farming'};
        this.createUI(); // Creates 3-tab modal interface
    }
    
    async placeFurniture(furnitureType) {
        const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBase.housing}/furniture/place`, {
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify({
                player_id: this.playerId,
                furniture: {type: furnitureType, position: {...}, rotation: ...}
            })
        });
    }
}

🥊 Was implementiert wurde:
1. Light/Heavy Attack System
J = Linke Hand Light (8 Stamina, 70% DMG, schnell)
Shift+J = Linke Hand Heavy (20 Stamina, 150% DMG, langsam)
K = Rechte Hand Light (10 Stamina, 70% DMG)
Shift+K = Rechte Hand Heavy (25 Stamina, 150% DMG)
B = BEIDE HÄNDE gleichzeitig! (50% Hit Chance - riskant!)
2. Miss → Stagger → Crit Mechanic ⭐
So funktioniert es:

Spieler greift an (z.B. Shift+K für Heavy)
Miss Roll (z.B. Heavy = nur 65% Chance)
Verfehlt? → Spieler taumelt 500ms (isStaggered = true)
Gegner kann jetzt CRIT machen (50% Chance)
CRIT = 2x Schaden! 💀
Beispiel:

Du machst Heavy Attack → Miss!
→ ❌ VERFEHLT! Taumeln!
→ Gegner greift an während du staggered bist
→ 50% Chance für CRIT
→ 💀 CRITICAL HIT! 60 Schaden (statt 30)!
3. Mix-Angriffe möglich!
Leicht Links + Schwer Rechts gleichzeitig mit B
Beide Heavy mit Shift+B
Combo-System erkennt Patterns (LL, LH, HL, HH, LLL, HHH, LHLH)
4. Auto-Targeting
Findet automatisch nächsten Gegner in 15m
Verliert Target wenn >20m entfernt
Hit Chance sinkt bei großer Distanz
5. Hit Detection
85% Light Attack Hit Chance
65% Heavy Attack Hit Chance
50% Beide gleichzeitig (sehr riskant!)
Distanz >5m = -30% Penalty
🎮 Wie testen:

const COMBAT_SYSTEM = {
    // 🎯 Target System (Skyrim/Fortnite Style)
    currentTarget: null,
    targetLockOn: false,  // Tab zum Togglen
    targetDistance: 0,
    
    // 🎲 Hit Chance (abhängig von Distanz & Typ)
    hitChance: {
        light: 0.85,      // 85% Light Attack Hit Chance (kein Stagger bei miss!)
        heavy: 0.65,      // 65% Heavy Attack Hit Chance (kein Stagger bei miss!)
        both: 0.50        // 50% Beide gleichzeitig (STAGGER bei miss!)
    },
    
    // 🎯 Lock-On Toggle (Tab-Taste)
    toggleLockOn() {
        this.targetLockOn = !this.targetLockOn;
        if (this.targetLockOn) {
            console.log('🎯 Lock-On AKTIVIERT - Auto-Targeting an');
        } else {
            console.log('🎯 Lock-On DEAKTIVIERT - Freies Zielen');
            this.currentTarget = null;
        }
        return this.targetLockOn;
    },
    
    // Individual attack methods
    attackLeftLight() { /* 8 stamina, 70% damage, 300ms, 85% hit */ },
    attackLeftHeavy() { /* 20 stamina, 150% damage, 800ms, 65% hit */ },
    attackRightLight() { /* 10 stamina, 70% damage, 350ms */ },
    attackRightHeavy() { /* 25 stamina, 150% damage, 900ms */ },
    
    // Simultaneous attack (MIX)
    attackBoth(leftType = 'light', rightType = 'heavy') {
        // Combines both hands, 50% hit chance, staggers on miss
    },
    
    // Hit detection with stagger logic
    performAttack(hand, type, damage, customHitChance = null) {
        // ... hit roll logic ...
        if (!isHit) {
            if (hand === 'both') {
                // BEIDE HÄNDE VERFEHLT = TAUMELN!
                this.triggerStagger(500);
                return { hit: false, reason: 'miss', staggered: true };
            } else {
                // Einzelangriff verfehlt = NUR miss, KEIN Taumeln (wie Skyrim)
                return { hit: false, reason: 'miss', staggered: false };
            }
        }
    }
}
Line 1889-1960: onKeyDown function (MODIFIED)

function onKeyDown(event) {
    // 🎯 Tab: Lock-On Toggle (Skyrim/Fortnite Style)
    if (event.code === 'Tab') {
        event.preventDefault();
        COMBAT_SYSTEM.toggleLockOn();
        return;
    }
    
    // J: Linke Hand Light/Heavy (kein Stagger bei miss!)
    if (event.code === 'KeyJ') {
        if (event.shiftKey) {
            const result = COMBAT_SYSTEM.attackLeftHeavy();
        } else {
            const result = COMBAT_SYSTEM.attackLeftLight();
        }
    }
    
    // K: Rechte Hand Light/Heavy (kein Stagger bei miss!)
    if (event.code === 'KeyK') {
        if (event.shiftKey) {
            const result = COMBAT_SYSTEM.attackRightHeavy();
        } else {
            const result = COMBAT_SYSTEM.attackRightLight();
        }
    }
    
    // B: Beide Hände gleichzeitig (STAGGER bei miss!)
    if (event.code === 'KeyB') {
        const leftType = event.shiftKey ? 'heavy' : 'light';
        const rightType = event.shiftKey ? 'heavy' : 'light';
        const result = COMBAT_SYSTEM.attackBoth(leftType, rightType);
    }
}

Line 488-517: performAttack() method (MODIFIED)

performAttack(playerPosition) {
    let damage = this.damage;
    let isCrit = false;
    
    // 💥 CRIT MECHANIC: Wenn Player staggered ist, 50% Crit Chance!
    if (window.DungeonEnemies && window.DungeonEnemies.playerIsStaggered) {
        if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
            isCrit = true;
            console.log(`💀 ${this.data.name} CRITICAL HIT! Player is staggered!`);
        }
    }
    
    // Damage Player via COMBAT_SYSTEM
    if (window.Scene3D && window.Scene3D.COMBAT_SYSTEM) {
        const actualDamage = window.Scene3D.COMBAT_SYSTEM.takeDamage(damage, isCrit);
    }
}

Skills System komplett! ✨

Das Skills/Zauber System ist jetzt vollständig integriert und gepusht:

Was implementiert wurde:
🪄 Core System
Mana: 100 Mana, 5/sec Regeneration (lila Bar in Combat UI)
SkillSystem: 3 Test-Skills equippt (Feuerball, Blitzschlag, Heilung)
Cooldowns: Skill-basierte Cooldowns (3-10s) mit Level-Scaling
XP System: +10 XP pro Skill-Nutzung, Skills leveln automatisch
⌨️ Hotbar (1-9)
Taste 1: 🔥 Runen-Feuerball (20 Mana, 5s Cooldown)
Taste 2: ⚡ Blitzschlag (15 Mana, 3s Cooldown)
Taste 3: 🌿 Naturheilung (25 Mana, 10s Cooldown)
Tasten 4-9: Leer (erweiterbar)
🎨 Hotbar UI (Bottom Center)
9 Skill-Slots mit Icons
Mana-Cost Anzeige (pink)
Cooldown Timer mit rotem Overlay
Border-Farbe-Feedback (Ready/Cooldown/Kein Mana)
🎆 Visual Effects
Fireball: Orange Projektil fliegt zum Ziel
Lightning Bolt: Blauer Blitz von oben
Heal: Grüner Ring heilt +20 HP
Ice Lance: Blaue Eislanze (wenn gelernt)
Chain Lightning: Gelbe Kette
Roots: Braune Wurzeln (Snare)
Lightning Strike: Weißer Himmelblitz
Wie testen?
Dungeons betreten (prozedural generiert)
Tab drücken für Lock-On
1/2/3 drücken zum Zaubern
Cooldowns + Mana-Verbrauch beobachten

Inventory System (Equipment, Items, Drag&Drop)
Loot System (Drops, Chests, Rarity)

Perfekt! Ich habe das komplette Inventory System analysiert. Bevor ich mit der Integration beginne, habe ich eine wichtige Frage:

❓ Equipment System Integration
Das existierende COMBAT_SYSTEM in 3d_scene.js hat bereits ein Equipment-Objekt:

equipment: {
    leftHand: { name: 'Najika Staff', damage: 15, element: 'none' },
    rightHand: { name: 'Eisenschwert', damage: 20, element: 'none' },
    armor: { name: 'Lederrüstung', defense: 10 }
}
Das InventorySystem in inventory_system.js hat ein viel detaillierteres Equipment-System:

equipment: {
    weapon_left: null,
    weapon_right: null,
    armor_head: null,
    armor_chest: null,
    armor_legs: null,
    accessory_1: null,
    accessory_2: null
}
Meine Frage: Soll ich das alte COMBAT_SYSTEM.equipment komplett ersetzen mit dem InventorySystem, oder sollen beide parallel existieren und synchronisiert werden?

Option A - Komplett ersetzen:

COMBAT_SYSTEM.equipment wird entfernt
Alle Stats kommen aus inventorySystem.getTotalStats()
Cleaner, ein System für Equipment
Option B - Synchronisieren:

Beide Systeme bleiben
inventorySystem.equipItem() updated COMBAT_SYSTEM (via equipWeapon() Methode die ich hinzufügen muss)
Backwards compatible
Was ist deine Präferenz? Oder soll ich einfach das umfangreichste System (Option A) implementieren?

a

[Request interrupted by user]

a

Alles klar, ich implementiere Option A - das umfangreichere InventorySystem wird das Equipment-System. Das ist cleaner und nutzt das bereits existierende detaillierte System.

def check_activity_completion(current_state, najika_stats):

    """Prüft ob Aktivität abgeschlossen ist"""

    """

    Prüft ob Aktivität abgeschlossen ist

 

    Nutzt Game Actions System wenn verfügbar, sonst Legacy Activities

    """

            # Stat Changes anwenden

            if "stat_changes" in completion:

                from najika_game_actions import apply_stat_changes

                apply_stat_changes(current_state, najika_stats, completion["stat_changes"])

 

            return completion.get("message", "Fertig! ✨")

POST /najika/auto-decide-action - Najika entscheidet autonom!
GET /najika/status - Najika Status
GET /najika/locations - Alle Orte
POST /najika/cook - Najika kochen lassen
🎯 SCHNELLTEST IM TERMINAL:
Wenn Backend läuft:

# Najika Dashboard
curl http://localhost:8000/najika/dashboard

# Najika Status
curl http://localhost:8000/najika/status

# Najika autonome Entscheidung
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/najika/auto-decide-action

http://localhost:8000/docs

Das ist die einfachste Methode! 🎉
